cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objective to demonstrate the impact of global thickness adjustment on regional thickness deficits in psychiatric disorders.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: We empirically demonstrated that this statistical approach severely underestimates regional thickness dysmorphology in psychiatric disorders... We hypothesized that 1) covarying for global thickness would attenuate or eliminate patient group regional thickness abnormalities...
